phase-plan.purpose: Implement the first Unreal-side hybrid browser flow so generated level content can be inspected inside the plugin before manual drag-drop placement into authored maps.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: plugin module scaffolding, payload subsystem, browser tab, example payload, and manual-first placement guidance. Out of scope: actor spawning and managed placement synchronization.
phase-plan.definition-of-done: Done when the plugin exposes a real editor tab that loads `level-browser.payload.v1`, browses levels, shows diagnostics, and ships with an example payload generated from the current schema-backed bundle.

file.description: Registers the Unreal browser tab and menu entry.
Implements the browser UI for overview, structure, content, assets, diagnostics, and placement guidance.
Real example payload generated from the current authored bundle.

task.description: Register a browser tab and menu entry in the Unreal plugin.
Implement a manual-first level browser UI and ship a generated example payload.
